Within the Fast Power Phase players may choose the sequence of Powers; no fixed player order is required.
After island setup, put remaining Presence on the dashed circles of the Spirit panel's Presence tracks.
Leave the leftmost solid-circle Energy and Card Plays numbers uncovered.
During Power Progression setup, set aside all listed Minor and Major Power Cards.
Those reserved cards do not remain in the shared shuffled decks for ordinary draws.
Setup Blight does not trigger the normal cascade rule.
Setup Blight does not destroy Presence; those normal adverse addition consequences apply after setup.
No Invader action is taken for a space with no Invader Card.
The first ordinary empty Ravage space therefore causes no Ravage: do not draw a Ravage card or invent a terrain for it.
Do not inspect all earned Fear Cards before resolving the first; reveal/read them one at a time without looking ahead.
Resolve the initial earned stack in the order the cards were earned.
After resolving a Fear Card, put it in the Fear Discard space.
Ordinary Power Damage may be freely divided among Invaders in the target land.
Players need not finish destroying one Invader before assigning Damage to another.
The proposed allocation of 1 Damage to the healthy Town and 2 to the healthy City is legal and leaves both as damaged survivors.
A single simultaneous replacement instruction selects all pieces before replacing any of them.
It cannot select one original City twice to chain City-to-Town-to-Explorer within that instruction; replace the selected pieces simultaneously.
Two separate players' legal Trade Suffers III actions may successively downgrade the same resulting piece.
The newly occupied matching land Ravages from the second Ravage Card in the stated case.
Determine a fresh affected-land list before resolving each card; eligibility is not locked once for the entire Ravage step.
Ocean uses printed, unmodified Invader Health for the Drowned-Invader Energy exchange.
Ignore all Health modifiers for that valuation, including both temporary and permanent modifiers.
Dissolve requires its Explorer Push to use as many different legal destination lands as possible.
With three pushed Explorers and three legal destination lands, send one Explorer to each of those three lands.
With only two legal destination lands, use both: one receives two Explorers and the other one.
Under Words of Warning the Dahan deal their Ravage Damage simultaneously with the Invaders, rather than only surviving Dahan attacking afterward.
A Dahan destroyed by that same simultaneous exchange still contributes its Ravage Damage.
For Entwined's subsequent gain, the using Spirit selects one of the cards the target did not keep from the initial draw; it does not draw a fresh four.
In solo the two cards gained through this base effect come from the same initial draw of four, not two independent draws.
Removed island Blight returns to the currently face-up Blight Card or board Blight pool, not to the box.
The currently face-up Blighted Island side also receives removed Blight.
Leave the token in the active Blight Card/board pool in use; do not place it in the land.
This prevented addition causes no Presence destruction.
This prevented addition causes no cascade.

The restored disks go directly into the supplied legal island land, not back onto Presence tracks.

The original target remains unchanged; qualifying destruction there still supplies the trigger.
If Explorers are present, Push all of them.
If there are no Explorers, instead remove one Blight.

The using Spirit and target Spirit may each gift one Power Card to the other.
Gifts must come from hand; cards in play and personal discard are ineligible.
Each Spirit may independently decline its gift.
Any fitting arrangement of the two balanced boards is legal; the illustrated bottom-to-bottom orientation is not required.
Yes; to use that Powerstorm Repeat, pay the repeated Power Card's Energy cost again, in addition to the original play payment.

Correct the illegal position after the completed action tree but before checking victory/defeat; check the cleaned-up state.
Apply the Speed-changing threshold when checking the Innate's Speed/phase, before its ordinary effects rather than waiting until ordinary effect resolution.
The delayed trigger remains Bringer's Power, follows To Dream a Thousand Deaths and deals hypothetical rather than real Damage; the other Spirit causing the trigger does not take ownership.

None are prohibited: all eight original-core Spirits are permitted in solo, including the named Ocean and Bringer.

Destroyed Presence may optionally supply Green’s Growth placements before tracks are empty.
This use is free while Healthy and costs 1 Energy per destroyed Presence added while Blighted.
Steady Regeneration applies to Growth, so an ordinary Power placement needs its own destroyed-Presence permission.
Ocean may exchange stored Drowned Invaders at the stated between-actions time in the later Spirit Phase; it need not wait for another Drowning or the normal Gain Energy step.
The explicit any-Ocean Growth instruction may place in another board’s Ocean without preexisting Presence there or a numeric Range origin.
The granted Element must be a type the target already has at least one of; an absent Element cannot be chosen.
Green performs the separate ALWAYS placement in addition to the selected Reclaim-and-gain-Power Growth group.
The same Town provides nightmare-destruction Fear only once during that single Tsunami use; moving it between affected lands does not reset the per-Power, per-Invader limit.
The Repeat resolves Elemental Boon’s explicit Element-grant effect again.
Any player may set that Spirit Phase time limit; it is not reserved for the owner/organizer.
